<!--
Document mode has no title page, so nothing cleared the page before the body
and it ran on under the last list: the title of the paper, its first heading
and its first figure shared a page with the list of tables. Manuscript and
student mode were never affected, since the title page clears it for them.

A document mode paper with no list is continuous as it always was -- the
break is there because a list is.
-->
